name: Undeterminable-owner whole-bucket read (positive; conditioned; hostile Sid rides through inert)
note: S2-crossaccount-scoped-surface iteration-5 (S3 fail-open close): s3:GetObject on a CANONICAL S3 bucket ARN (arn:aws:s3:::partner-data-bucket/*) is a whole-container read, but a canonical bucket ARN carries NO account field and no aws:ResourceAccount / s3:ResourceAccount condition pins the owner, so the owning account cannot be determined from the policy. Before the fix this read affirmatively CLEAN even with a known subject account (context.subjectAccount 123456789012) - the archetypal exfil primitive silently cleared. It now surfaces at INFO as CROSS-ACCOUNT-DATA-READ-UNDETERMINED so 'complete'/'CLEAN' is never a safety claim here, WITHOUT fabricating a confirmed cross-account claim. The bucket name is NEUTRAL (the sensitivity wordlist RAISES severity, never gates reporting). A narrowing Condition (aws:SourceVpc, orthogonal to account-determinability) is present so it still fires conditioned, and the Sid embeds an HTML/JS payload that must survive verbatim in the finding as inert DATA.
